answer: Each agent can act freely, but only agents that lock a scarce stake can vote on shared reputation updates. A vote is accepted only after independent reviewers verify the cited interaction and stake is slashed if the claim is disproved. One operator can still create many identities, but must lock capital for each and risks losing it when those identities coordinate false reports. The stake is no relic or dune token by itself: the thread of evidence and the penalty make Sybil influence costly.
